gaps.lead: Both sisters play the violin beautifully.
gaps.sentence: The sisters ___ play the violin beautifully.
gaps.explanation: Both (the) sisters… / The sisters both… — with the given frame, 'both' precedes the verb.

gaps.lead: As soon as the results were announced, people started celebrating.
gaps.sentence: The results had ___ people started celebrating.
gaps.explanation: No sooner had the results been announced than… — reordered to fit the frame.

gaps.lead: I can't wait for the holidays to begin.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing/noun: looking forward to the holidays beginning.
